description: This file declares an interface (IRDKWindowManager) for managing window-related functionalities, notifications, input controls, and application state in a TV or media device environment, within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager
classes.description: An interface for window management, notifications, input handling, and application state operations.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager::INotification
classes.description: A nested interface for receiving window and application notifications such as focus, visibility, connection status, and inactivity.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification handler for window and app events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification handler.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with the service context.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the window manager, likely releasing resources.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display window with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently active application IDs.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercept
methods.description: Registers a key intercept for specific key codes and clients.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Registers multiple key intercepts at once.

methods.name: RemoveKeyIntercept
methods.description: Removes a specific key intercept.

methods.name: AddKeyListener
methods.description: Registers key listeners for specified keys.

methods.name: RemoveKeyListener
methods.description: Removes key listeners for specified keys.

methods.name: InjectKey
methods.description: Simulates a key press event with optional modifiers.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a key event for specific keys and client.

methods.name: EnableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Enables or disables inactivity reporting feature.

methods.name: SetInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the interval for inactivity detection.

methods.name: ResetInactivityTime
methods.description: Resets the inactivity timer.

methods.name: EnableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeat behavior.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: IgnoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Sets whether key inputs are ignored.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables or disables key input events for specified clients.

methods.name: KeyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Configures key repeat parameters such as delay and interval.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to a specified application or client.

methods.name: SetVisible
methods.description: Sets visibility state of a specified client or application.

methods.name: RenderReady
methods.description: Checks if the first frame of an app is rendered.

methods.name: EnableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables rendering of a Wayland display.

methods.name: GetLastKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the last key press event, including key code, modifiers, and timestamp.
